stem.text: Which row gives the correct description of **both** a collagen molecule and a collagen fibre?

A.text: $\alpha$ and $\beta$ polypeptide chains forming a double helix, held together by disulfide bonds; molecules of collagen arranged randomly to each other, linked by hydrogen bonds

B.text: a polypeptide chain, with repeating amino acids, forming an $\alpha$-helix; three molecules of collagen, forming a triple helix, held together by hydrogen bonds

C.text: a polypeptide chain, with three repeating amino acids, forming a helix; three $\alpha$ helical collagen molecules, forming a triple helix, held together by ionic bonds

D.text: three helical polypeptide chains, forming a triple helix, held together by hydrogen bonds; molecules of collagen lying parallel and cross-linked to each other
